blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Four Persons Deprived of Liberty at the Cebu Provincial Detention and Rehabilitation Center are facing additional charges after authorities seized illegal drugs from their cells during an inspection. The inmates identified only by the aliases “Rob Ben,” “Kobe,” “John Keneith,” and “Arni” are all adults currently detained on prior drug-related offenses. Operatives […]...
